create_LlavaProcessor: create an LlavaProcessor instance with image_processor, tokenizer, patch_size, and vision_feature_select_strategy
call_LlavaProcessor: call the LlavaProcessor with images and text to produce input_ids, attention_mask, and pixel_values
configure_LlavaProcessorKwargs: configure LlavaProcessorKwargs with padding and return_mm_token_type_ids options for text tokenization
compute_multimodal_tokens: compute the number of multimodal tokens for given image sizes using _get_num_multimodal_tokens
generate_mm_token_type_ids: generate multimodal token type ids for input_ids using create_mm_token_type_ids
